headline: Poland denounces Russian provocation after missiles fall near the Ukrainian border
summary: Mexico's Fovissste housing fund cut mortgage formalization time from more than 60 days to 42 days. It is working with financial institutions and notaries to reach 30 days.
why: Fovissste is Mexico's public housing fund for state workers, and faster mortgage processing affects access to credit and the housing finance market.
original_headline: Polonia denuncia provocación rusa tras la caída de misiles cerca de la frontera ucraniana
